notes: Compile-time mirror of resources/compatibility.json. Kept byte-identical by hand; it is only used when the bundled resource file is missing or corrupt so the app degrades instead of silently reporting 'all clear'.

incompatible_pairs.reason: Brita's weapon pack targets the older Arsenal(26) GunFighter main module. The 2.0 main module replaced the item registrations it hooks into, so loading both together leaves duplicate weapon items and a broken inventory.
Arsenal(26) GunFighter 2.0 is a full replacement of the original module, not an add-on to it. Both versions declare the same item ids, so only one can be active.
Global Mod Options has separate Build 41 and Build 42 implementations. Enabling both runs two mod-option menus and one of them registers against the wrong game build.

required_libraries.reason: Brita's weapon pack registers ammo and guns through Arsenal(26) GunFighter. Without that library the weapons never appear in the inventory.
Vehicle Scene Customization patches Tsar's vehicle definitions at load time. Without Tsarslib it raises a Lua error during vehicle creation.

game_versions.reason: The Build 42 Global Mod Options rewrite does not run on Build 41; on 41 the mod loads but its options menu never appears.
The Build 41 Global Mod Options rewrite is replaced by the native Build 42 mod-options system, so on Build 42 it can be switched off.
